author: Google Keyword blog (Sundar Pichai, Demis Hassabis, Koray Kavukcuoglu)
text: We're also introducing Gemini 3 Deep Think ... and giving access to safety testers before making it available to Google AI Ultra subscribers.

author: Google Keyword blog (Sundar Pichai, Demis Hassabis, Koray Kavukcuoglu)
text: For Gemini 3 Deep Think mode, we're taking extra time for safety evaluations and input from safety testers before making it available to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the coming weeks.

author: Google Keyword blog (The Deep Think team)
text: for the first time, we're also making Deep Think available via the Gemini API to select researchers, engineers and enterprises. Express interest in early access here.
notes: Whitelist early access; no public API by 2026-11-20.

author: Google Keyword blog (Google Gemini team)
text: We are releasing 3.1 Pro in preview today to validate these updates and continue to make further advancements in areas such as ambitious agentic workflows before we make it generally available soon.
notes: No GA endpoint found through 2026-11-20 (models page lists only gemini-3.1-pro-preview).

author: Google Keyword blog (Koray Kavukcuoglu, Jeff Dean, Oriol Vinyals, Noam Shazeer)
text: We're also hard at work on 3.5 Pro. It's already being used internally, and we look forward to rolling it out next month.

author: Google Keyword blog (News from Google team, I/O 2026 recap)
text: We're also hard at work on Gemini 3.5 Pro. It's already being used internally and we look forward to rolling it out next month.
notes: Item 6 of "100 things we announced at I/O 2026"; restates the keynote promise.

author: Google Keyword blog (Tulsee Doshi, Google)
text: Gemini 3.5 Pro is currently testing with partners and we plan to make it broadly available as soon as it's ready.
notes: Same post closes: "look forward to releasing 3.5 Pro soon." Never broadly released within the period.

author: Google Keyword blog (Tulsee Doshi, Google)
text: We have started our most ambitious pre-training run yet, for Gemini 4, and are excited by the progress.
notes: First official mention of Gemini 4; first Gemini 4 model (Argon) announced 2026-09-30.

author: Google Keyword blog (Koray Kavukcuoglu)
text: In the coming weeks, we'll also be rolling it out to developers and enterprise customers via APIs.

author: Google DeepMind blog (Raluca Ada Popa, Four Flynn)
text: As part of a limited-access pilot program, 3.5 Flash Cyber will be exclusively available to governments and trusted partners via CodeMender soon, expanding over time.

author: Google Keyword blog (Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP Google DeepMind)
text: Today, we're announcing our new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, which is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program.

author: Google Keyword blog (Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP Google DeepMind)
text: ...before we release to developers, enterprises, and consumers, starting with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers.
notes: General release came 2026-10-13 (paid API; Gemini app for Pro and Ultra).

author: Google Keyword blog
text: We have started rolling out Genie 4 to a limited group of trusted testers. It's coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners in the Gemini API and AI Studio.

author: Google Keyword blog (Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP Google DeepMind)
text: Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program.

author: Google Keyword blog (Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP Google DeepMind)
text: We're eager to see how the initial cohort of cyber defenders use this model and we look forward to bringing Carbon to developers, businesses, and consumers soon.
